info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_System Configuration Management API
info.description: The System Configuration Management API allows developers to modify and update system settings related to IT management within the banking environment. This API facilitates the patching of existing configurations, enabling efficient management of system parameters. Typical consumers include system administrators and IT teams who need to ensure that various system components are up to date and operating optimally. This endpoint is critical for maintaining the integrity and functionality of banking IT systems.

patch.summary: Update system administration details for RES-100045.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the system administration details for the resource identified by RES-100045. It enables modifications to key attributes and settings that govern the resource's management and operation within the IT infrastructure.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to modify the properties of the specified system administration resource identified by RES-100045. The payload must adhere to the schema defined for the operations associated with this resource and should reflect the changes intended for the update.
